purpose: Test a teacher-free globally consistent mechanical partition suitable for Stage17 repair, using Stage35 incompatibility evidence rather than sparse primal-edge deletion.
owner_hypothesis: Stage17 currently conflates geometric adjacency with mechanical PRESERVE_CONTINUITY. Stage35 must return mechanical boundary evidence that is solved into a consistent Stage17 partition before Stage18 rebuild.

solver.event_order: descending confidence; repulsive before attractive on exact ties; deterministic endpoint tie-break
solver.attractive_action: union current components only if no mutex exists
solver.neutral_action: processed as zero-confidence attractive after all positive-confidence evidence

repair_projection: The resulting vertex partition is evaluated directly and through the existing holeless region-pure subdivision operator. A production Stage17 repair would derive exhaustive SEPARATE/PRESERVE constraints from the solved partition.
teacher_policy: Teacher topology is evaluation-only after partition labels are frozen. Teacher weights are used only after inference for topology-mechanics isolation.
